name: Callicoon Indoor Winter Farmers' Market
description: Callicoon Indoor Winter Farmers' Market is a farmers market in 8 Creamery Road Callicoon, NY, bringing together local growers, bakers, and makers. Shoppers can find seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from area farms. Hours and availability change with the season, so confirm before visiting.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
